decompose.title: Decompose the 20-person workshop
decompose.summary: Connect venue, learning material and invitation work to the workshop outcome; give each action a checked finish state.

nodes.label: Beginner workshop outcome
nodes.description: Deliver one usable 60-minute workshop and exercise sheet for 20 beginners; video production is outside the initial scope.

nodes.label: Venue arrangement
nodes.description: Create a deliverable covering capacity, location and participation constraints so publication has reliable venue information.

nodes.label: Learning material
nodes.description: Create the exercise sheet and instructions needed for the beginner session, including a usable first step.

nodes.label: Participant invitation
nodes.description: Create accurate date, venue, registration and participation-contact information.

nodes.label: Confirm, draft and review actions
nodes.description: Assign an owner to each bounded action. Include creation, checking and handoff rather than listing writing alone.

nodes.label: Checked completion states
nodes.description: Retain confirmation or accepted file links as evidence. Time spent and moving a card do not establish completion.

sequence.title: Parallel branches with genuine dependencies
sequence.summary: Venue confirmation enables invitation publication. Exercise drafting can run independently, but both branches meet at a final consistency check.

nodes.label: Agree audience and date
nodes.description: Set the workshop audience, provisional date and shared terminology before the independent branches create conflicting promises.

nodes.label: Confirm venue
nodes.description: Obtain the address and seated capacity from the venue contact; the invitation cannot publish an unconfirmed address.

nodes.label: Publish checked invitation
nodes.description: Check the accepted venue input, date and registration route before making the invitation available.

nodes.label: Draft exercise sheet
nodes.description: Begin learning-material drafting while venue confirmation is in progress; the draft does not require the final address.

nodes.label: Review exercise sheet
nodes.description: Review requires an existing draft. Check the first step, expected duration and supporting material.

nodes.label: Integrate workshop materials
nodes.description: Compare the invitation’s promises with the reviewed exercises and the actual session duration. Resolve mismatches before delivery.

wip.title: A blocked review still consumes WIP
wip.summary: With a limit of two, one draft and one blocked review occupy both slots. Finish or unblock before starting a third item unless an explicit exception is agreed.

nodes.label: Count two started items
nodes.description: Doing contains one draft; Review contains one blocked card. Both have started and neither is finished, so WIP equals two.

nodes.label: Below limit two?
nodes.description: Compare started unfinished work with the agreed limit across Doing and Review, including blocked items.

nodes.label: Finish or unblock existing work
nodes.description: At the limit, work on the draft or obtain the missing review input. Do not create a hidden extra started task.

nodes.label: An item reaches Done
nodes.description: A card exits WIP only when its completion criteria pass. Moving a blocked card to a hidden list does not release capacity.

nodes.label: Pull one ready item
nodes.description: When WIP drops to one, select a clear useful item with available inputs; pulling it restores WIP to two.

blocked.title: Resolve a venue blocker with a timed fallback
blocked.summary: Publication needs venue capacity tomorrow. The owner follows up today, then asks the decision authority to select a backup if the input remains missing.

nodes.label: Missing seated capacity
nodes.description: Venue confirmation has had no reply for two days; invitation publication depends on that specific input.

nodes.label: Mira follows up at 14:00
nodes.description: Mira owns the item and asks the venue contact for the missing capacity, stating the publication consequence.

nodes.label: Reply received by 17:00?
nodes.description: Inspect the actual reply for usable capacity information; silence or an unrelated acknowledgement does not unblock the invitation.

nodes.label: Check and use venue input
nodes.description: Confirm the capacity supports 20 attendees, update the invitation and inspect dependent dates.

nodes.label: Jo selects backup venue
nodes.description: If the reply is still missing, ask Jo to make the agreed backup decision; Mira coordinates rather than assumes approval authority.

nodes.label: Confirm backup details
nodes.description: Obtain the selected backup’s address and capacity before publication. Keep the card blocked and counted as WIP until the needed input is usable.

review.title: Verification and validation reveal different problems
review.summary: A section checklist may pass while a beginner cannot find the first step. Preserve both forms of evidence and revise the intended-use obstacle.

nodes.label: Draft exercise sheet
nodes.description: The sheet contains the required sections but has not yet been accepted for the beginner session.

nodes.label: Verify required sections
nodes.description: Check each specified section and factual detail; record the file version and the checks actually executed.

nodes.label: Beginner can start unaided?
nodes.description: Observe the named starting task and record assistance. A complete section list does not guarantee usable instructions.

nodes.label: Revise first instruction
nodes.description: If the learner cannot identify the first step, rewrite that instruction and inspect any affected section checks.

nodes.label: Record scoped acceptance
nodes.description: When the intended task succeeds, retain the verified file and observed validation result. State the learner/task scope rather than claiming universal usability.

close.title: Close delivery without hiding remaining work
close.summary: Archive accepted materials while transferring the unresolved access issue and recurring attendance task to named owners who accept them.

nodes.label: Accepted materials and feedback
nodes.description: Link the delivered invitation, exercise sheet and observed feedback. Attendance alone does not establish learning success.

nodes.label: Open access issue
nodes.description: Record the unresolved participation issue, its impact and a follow-up date instead of deleting it from the closure report.

nodes.label: Ongoing attendance routine
nodes.description: Separate the recurring Friday attendance check from the completed workshop project and state its trigger.

nodes.label: Owners accept follow-up
nodes.description: Confirm a named person accepts each ongoing obligation. Archiving a card without ownership merely hides the work.

nodes.label: Archive closure evidence
nodes.description: Store accepted links, limitations, outstanding obligations and the route for future corrections together.
